notes.title: 🎙️【Voice Sample Release】Our Gummy Bear Heroine Speaks! 🐻💕
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/f6ceeda343f487b8a85ea488314d2835131e075a.png

Ever wondered what it feels like when your lazy, squishy gummy bear finally talks back to you? 🍬✨

We’re excited to share the very first voice sample of our sweet heroine!
Listen to her sleepy whispers and playful lines here:
👉
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U9mbgGlS3fM

This is just the beginning — full voice acting is coming to Gummy Bear Idle: No Job, Just Jelly♥.
Would you let her soft voice keep you company while she naps all day? 💭💤

Don’t forget to add us to your Steam wishlist so you won’t miss the full release!
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206860/_/

notes.title: Due to the hospitalization of one of our voice actors for health reasons, the release of Doki Boki’s voice recordings and ASMR will be slightly delayed.
notes.notes:

Health always comes first. We hope that everyone also takes care of themselves and stays healthy amidst your busy schedules.
